preconditions.description: Number of towns is between 3 and 100,000.
Number of monasteries is between 2 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= monastery <= n for monastery in monasteries)
preconditions.description: All monastery indices are within the range of town indices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and 1 <= ci <= 1000 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge indices and lengths are within valid ranges.

preconditions.expression: all(ai != bi for ai, bi, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a town to itself.

postconditions.description: The maximum number of unhappy pilgrims is non-negative.
The number of ways to make the maximum number of pilgrims unhappy is non-negative.
The maximum number of unhappy pilgrims cannot exceed the total number of pilgrims.
